understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked '+' at the same time; if there are multiple goals, all must be occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and advance through all levels until the final win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each MOVE action attempts to shift the currently selected piece by one cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction, but movement can be prevented by walls/boundaries or sometimes behave unexpectedly depending on obstacle interactions. Some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be moved if the selected piece moves into them and the pushed space is free. Levels may have multiple selectable pieces; control can be switched using CLICK on the exact pixel-coordinate position of another selectable, and success depends on using the correct coordinate system (the same [x,y] space shown for player.position/objects). The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not strictly determine whether a move will succeed.

understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked '+' at the same time; if there are multiple goals, all must be occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and advance through all levels until the final win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each MOVE action attempts to shift the currently selected piece by one cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction, but movement can be prevented by walls/boundaries or sometimes behave unexpectedly depending on obstacle interactions. Some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be moved if the selected piece moves into them and the pushed space is free. Levels may have multiple selectable pieces; control can be switched using CLICK on the exact pixel-coordinate position of another selectable, and success depends on using the correct coordinate system (the same [x,y] space shown for player.position/objects). The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not strictly determine whether a move will succeed.
